description: This file is a Bash shell script used for automating end-to-end smoke testing of a Parallels macOS virtual machine environment. It manages VM snapshots, installation, verification, onboarding, dashboard checks, Discord integrations, and logging, tailored for a specific project involving OpenClaw in a macOS Parallels VM setup.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Resolves the most appropriate VM snapshot based on a fuzzy matching hint, returning snapshot ID, state, and name.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Checks the status of the OpenClaw gateway to ensure it is operational.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Performs a verification step by setting a model and validating a response to confirm operational status.

methods.name: verify_dashboard_load
methods.description: Checks if the OpenClaw dashboard URL loads correctly and contains expected HTML elements, then opens it in Safari.

methods.name: capture_latest_ref_failure
methods.description: Runs onboard with the latest release to check for failure cases related to ref mode onboarding, reporting status.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Performs the 'fresh' lane of testing: restore snapshot, install main, verify versions, onboard, check dashboard, and Discord integration.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Performs the 'upgrade' lane of testing: restore snapshot, upgrade to latest, verify, onboard, check dashboard, and Discord integration.
